messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH error rate on /v1/generate (prod-us-west). Symptom: sudden KV cache evictions -> downstream 500s. Alert: INC-2141122334. Links: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/INC-2141122334

emma: @raj are you oncall? seeing the pager and some customer pings in #support.

raj: oncall here, looking now. pulling logs and heap stats. started tailing inference-runtime logs.

raj: quick note: looks like a burst of long sequences caused the KV store to evict aggressively, leading to cache misses + latency spikes.

mira: can you quantify customer impact? CS saw a few enterprise sessions fail. @leila any more detail?

leila: flagged 5 active enterprise tenants with failures between 14:07-14:20 PST, two support cases opened (TKT-5584, TKT-5585). Customers: AcmeApps, MarketGrid.

raj: mitigation plan in-flight: 1) increase kv.eviction_ttl temporarily, 2) pin most common model variants to avoid cold cache, 3) slow roll traffic to fallback smaller model for heavy seqs. executing step 1 now.

raj: ```bash
kubectl -n inference set env ds/kv-store KV_EVICTION_TTL=600
kubectl rollout restart ds/kv-store
```

devops-bot: Command executed: kubectl set env (job id: 9421). rollout restart succeeded on 3/3 pods.

oscar: good call. i'm running a quick smoke to verify 500 rate drops.

oscar: smoke results: 500s drop from ~18% -> ~3% in the last 4m. latency tail improved from 780ms -> 260ms.

emma: thanks — will message affected customers and mark incident status.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring. Incident commander: raj. Duration so far: ~18m.

raj: handing off to post-incident follow-up. I'll keep the incident channel open for any new blips, but switching to remediation planning.

mira: can we schedule a postmortem? proposing tomorrow 11:00 PST. I can lead RCA and reproduce sequence patterns.

leila: that works for me; I'll bring the customer timelines and CS notes.

emma: i'll own runbook edits and postmortem writeup. will update the on-call playbook with action items.

oscar: i'll own instrumentation task to add a seq-length heatmap to the routing dashboard.

raj: created follow-up ticket REDINF-827: "KV eviction thrash - RCA + runbook updates". Assigned: mira (RCA), emma (runbook), oscar (metrics), raj (patch). ETA: 5 business days. Link: https://issues.redwood.example/REDINF-827

devops-bot: Ticket REDINF-827 created by raj.

mira: immediate action items I want captured in the postmortem: - reproduce at smaller scale - test eviction threshold matrix - add canary for seq-length-induced load - confirm fallback model routing correctness

emma: runbook edits to include: - pre-approved mitigation commands (kubectl snippet) - who to page for KV and runtime - rollback checklist - how to escalate to Dedicated fallback (policy and contact)

oscar: suggested runbook snippet to add: ```yaml
healthchecks:
  - kv_cache_eviction_rate > 0.05 -> circuit_breaker: engage_fallback_model
```

raj: agree. also we should add an automatic pager rule for seq-length heat spikes. right now we only alert on error rate.

leila: I'll attach customer impact summaries to the postmortem doc and send CS follow-up templates to affected accounts.

emma: scheduling: I created the calendar invite for the postmortem: 2026-03-16 11:00 PST. Invite: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/pm-REDINF-827

mira: confirmed. I'll prepare a short repro deck and a heap/trace dump.

raj: final note before I drop off: temporary config remains until we test thresholds in staging. Do not promote to prod change without RCA + rollout plan.

emma: copied. I'll track progress in the ticket and update runbook PR at https://git.redwood.example/docs/runbooks/pulls/42

incident-bot: Incident INC-2141122334 -> status: mitigated. Closed to active paging at 14:32 PST. Postmortem scheduled.

oscar: I'll add a short postmortem action column in our weekly eng-sre board so we don't lose the follow-ups.

mira: thanks team. good first-line work. I'll post an initial RCA draft in REDINF-827 by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

emma: thanks all — closing channel for now. reopen if anything new appears.
